name: mod-firearms-shop
about: Through the firearms_shop bot: the town's equipment seller (Town/EquipmentSeller.as override, HWP/Firearms/Shops.as) offers the fixture's Paladin no gun in 8 offers; a fresh Firearms Specialist gets 8 offers whose weapons are all guns with at least one gun, and after she buys the guns out a gun is back in the stock on the next open.
